event: Pickett-Pettigrew-Trimble infantry step off from Seminary Ridge

Consistency check: a 2:00pm step-off would put the lines at the wall by ~2:30, contradicting the 3:10-3:45 arrival given by every source read; so the step-off cannot be much earlier than ~2:30-2:45. Needs historian review. WPmain "Around 3 p.m." footnote: Coddington p.402; McPherson p.662; Eicher p.546; Trudeau p.484; Walsh p.281.
